title: Revise global tokens: density, type scale, spacing, and elevation
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: Update the core design tokens to standardize density (compact vs default), tighten the type scale for improved hierarchy at small sizes, rationalize spacing and corner radius values, and replace the ad-hoc shadow set with a 3-tier elevation token system.

Goals:
- Provide a compact and default density token set so product teams can opt into tighter chrome without bespoke overrides.
- Simplify type scale: reduce the number of intermediary sizes, ensure readable defaults on 13–16px body sizes, and harmonize weight usage across components.
- Normalize spacing and radius tokens to a 4px baseline with clear aliases for component-level tokens (button, input, card).
- Introduce elevation tokens (elevation-0/1/2) with explicit shadow values for light/dark themes that map to runtime CSS variables and native mobile primitives.

Scope and out-of-scope:
- In scope: token definitions (colors not included in this ticket), token aliases, updated component snapshots (buttons, tables, cards, modals), migration guide, Figma token update, and engineering token export pipeline changes.
- Out of scope: full color palette overhaul, typography font-family changes, or redesigns of component anatomy beyond spacing/elevation/type adjustments.

Constraints and considerations:
- Must preserve accessibility contrast ratios for text tokens when paired with current colors; any type size reduction must not drop below AA on primary text use cases.
- Avoid breaking customer CSS: provide compatibility aliases and a deprecation window for legacy tokens.
- Engineering needs stable CSS variable names for runtime feature flags (density=compact).

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Figma token library updated and published.
- Components updated in the living component library with visual diffs reviewed and approved by PM and Eng.
- Migration guide added to the Design System docs with code snippets and a deprecation schedule.
- QA checklist verifying spacing, type, and elevation across the list of canonical pages (dashboard, settings, embed).
acceptance_criteria: All major components have updated snapshots and unit tests
Migration guide with deprecation dates published in docs
Cross-theme shadows validated for dark and light themes
migration_notes: Plan: 1) Publish new tokens under stable names and expose aliases that map legacy tokens to new ones. 2) Ship a feature flag 'density=compact' that toggles compact token aliases. 3) Provide a codemod for common JS/CSS token usage and a short guide for third-party customers. 4) Deprecate legacy tokens after one release (approx 8 weeks) with clear changelog entries.
release_notes: Introduces compact density option, tightened type scale for small-screen readability, standardized 4px spacing baseline, and a three-level elevation token set. Backwards-compatible aliases included; breaking changes only for teams that switch to renamed tokens. See migration guide for steps.
